title: WhatsApp: the Inbox warns you if the nightly program update needs a look
text: The WhatsApp program on the Mac now updates itself every night. If an update goes wrong, falls back to the old version, or the nightly check stops running, a banner at the top of the WhatsApp tab tells you in plain words what happened and what to do.
points: Amber banner: the update went back to the old version, or needs a review
Red banner: WhatsApp may be down after an update
Nothing shows when all is well

steps.name: Open the WhatsApp tab
steps.detail: The banner sits at the top, only when something needs a look.

steps.name: Read the banner
steps.detail: It says what happened and whether messages still work.

steps.name: Tell Claude
steps.detail: Amber and red banners say to ask Claude to look at it.
